parameters.name: Concurrency
parameters.description: The concurrency limit for the MapRun runtime. The default quota for a single account is 300. You can request a quota increase in Quota Center.

parameters.name: MapRunName
parameters.description: Name of the MapRun. Retrieve this value from the output of the `MapRunStarted` event.

parameters.name: ToleratedFailedCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of failed items that are allowed.

parameters.name: ToleratedFailedPercentage
parameters.description: The maximum percentage of failed items that are allowed. Valid range: 0 to 100.
